headerDisplay: Matter-only MQTT measurements. The default outlet remains backward compatible. Native Electrical Meter, Electrical Sensor, Solar Power and Battery Storage types require Homebridge 2.5.0+ and are experimental in Apple Home. Each device remains behind the Matter bridge; standalone publishing is not supported by Homebridge's public API.

id.title: Stable ID (optional)
id.description: Optional stable identity. If omitted, the power MQTT topic is used. Keep this ID unchanged when changing topics.

deviceType.title: Matter device type (experimental)
deviceType.description: outlet preserves previous pairing and Apple Home watt display. Native types need Homebridge 2.5+. Solar Power requires energyExportedTopic; Battery Storage requires batterySocTopic; Electrical Meter requires a cumulative energy topic. Battery Storage also requires batteryCapacityMah.

topic.title: Power topic
topic.description: Numeric MQTT payload containing active power.

multiplier.title: Power multiplier
multiplier.description: Multiply the power payload before publishing watts. Use 1000 when the topic is in kW.

voltageTopic.title: Voltage topic (optional)
voltageTopic.description: Numeric MQTT payload with AC voltage in V. For SolarPower this must describe the PV inverter AC output, not the grid connection's net power.

voltageMultiplier.title: Voltage multiplier
voltageMultiplier.description: Multiply the voltage payload before publishing volts.

currentTopic.title: Current topic (optional)
currentTopic.description: Signed active current in A. ElectricalSensor and ElectricalMeter preserve sign; SolarPower treats magnitude as outgoing PV current (negative Matter mA). Do not use household grid current as total PV current.

currentMultiplier.title: Current multiplier
currentMultiplier.description: Multiply the current payload before publishing amps.

energyImportedTopic.title: Imported/consumed energy topic (optional)
energyImportedTopic.description: Monotonically increasing cumulative energy counter. Do not use a daily counter that resets to zero. For BatteryStorage: charging energy. For solarPower use energyExportedTopic instead.

energyExportedTopic.title: Exported/returned energy topic (optional)
energyExportedTopic.description: Monotonically increasing LIFETIME exported energy in Wh or kWh. SolarPower: total PV generated, including self-consumption and battery charging; never the grid feed-in meter or a daily-reset yield.

batterySocTopic.title: Battery SoC topic (experimental)
batterySocTopic.description: Numeric MQTT payload from 0 to 100 percent. Valid only for default outlet and native batteryStorage; ignored with a warning on electricalMeter/electricalSensor/solarPower. Apple Home battery display/update support is limited.

batteryDcPowerTopic.title: Battery DC power topic (optional)
batteryDcPowerTopic.description: For batteryStorage only. Signed battery DC power in watts, positive = charging, negative = discharging. Unknown if not provided.

batteryCapacityMah.title: Battery rated capacity (mAh, native storage only)
batteryCapacityMah.description: Required when deviceType=batteryStorage. The physical pack's capacity in milliamp-hours (e.g. BYD HVS 12.8 kWh at nominal 512 V: 25000 mAh). Matter requires this value; do not enter kWh here.

batteryMaxChargePowerW.title: Battery max charging power (W; native storage)
batteryMaxChargePowerW.description: Optional native BatteryStorage real maximum charging power into battery, in watts. Used by mandatory read-only DeviceEnergyManagement. If absent, zero W is reported as test-only placeholder.

batteryMaxDischargePowerW.title: Battery max discharging power (W; native storage)
batteryMaxDischargePowerW.description: Optional native BatteryStorage real maximum discharging power from battery, in watts. Used by mandatory read-only DeviceEnergyManagement. If absent, zero W is reported as test-only placeholder.

batteryAdjustmentTestMode.title: SIMULATION: Battery adjustment control UI test (no MQTT writes)
batteryAdjustmentTestMode.description: Advanced test ONLY for native BatteryStorage. Advertises a synthetic ±1000 W adjustment capability to probe Matter controllers. ALL control requests fail; no MQTT commands are sent. Changes this device's Matter identity; turning off recreates its normal endpoint. Leave false for normal use.

reactivePowerTopic.title: AC reactive power topic (optional)
reactivePowerTopic.description: Signed reactive power in var; sent in milli-var. Available for AC ElectricalSensor/Meter and SolarPower. Use actual source readings; do not derive the sign.

energyExportedDailyTopic.title: PV energy generated today topic (optional, SolarPower only)
energyExportedDailyTopic.description: SolarPower or ElectricalSensor. Periodic exported energy since local midnight, not the lifetime counter. On enabling, changes identity to advertise PeriodicEnergy.

energyExportedDailyUnit.title: PV daily energy unit
energyExportedDailyUnit.description: Unit for energyExportedDailyTopic. Period is local midnight through the MQTT reading.

reactiveCurrentTopic.title: Reactive current (A)
reactiveCurrentTopic.description: Signed reactive current, amps; sent as Matter mA.

apparentCurrentTopic.title: Apparent current (A)
apparentCurrentTopic.description: Signed apparent current, amps; sent as Matter mA.

apparentPowerTopic.title: Apparent power (VA)
apparentPowerTopic.description: Signed apparent power, volt-amperes; sent as Matter mVA.

rmsVoltageTopic.title: RMS voltage (V)
rmsVoltageTopic.description: Non-negative AC RMS voltage, sent as Matter mV.

rmsCurrentTopic.title: RMS current (A)
rmsCurrentTopic.description: Signed AC RMS current, sent as Matter mA.

rmsPowerTopic.title: RMS power (W)
rmsPowerTopic.description: Signed AC RMS power, sent as Matter mW.

frequencyTopic.title: Frequency (Hz)
frequencyTopic.description: Non-negative grid/inverter AC frequency (Hz); sent as Matter mHz.

powerFactorTopic.title: Power factor (signed ratio)
powerFactorTopic.description: Use signed ratio -1.0 to +1.0 (e.g. 0.98). Matter expects 1/100ths percent: 0.98 -> 9800.

neutralCurrentTopic.title: Polyphase neutral current (A)
neutralCurrentTopic.description: ElectricalSensor only. Signed neutral current A; activates Matter PolyphasePower feature, recreating the endpoint identity.

harmonicCurrentsTopic.title: Harmonic currents JSON array (A)
harmonicCurrentsTopic.description: ElectricalSensor only. JSON array [{"order":3,"measurement":0.12}]; numeric measurement is A, sent as Matter mA. Activates Harmonics feature.

harmonicPhasesTopic.title: Harmonic phases JSON array (degrees)
harmonicPhasesTopic.description: ElectricalSensor only. JSON array [{"order":3,"measurement":12.5}]; numeric measurement is degrees, sent as Matter millidegrees. Activates PowerQuality feature.

energyImportedDailyTopic.title: Imported energy today (ElectricalSensor)
energyImportedDailyTopic.description: ElectricalSensor only. Non-negative amount since local midnight, NOT cumulative lifetime energy. Published as Matter PeriodicEnergyImported with timestamps. Changes device identity.
